thread:
sam_sales: FYI customer (Cypress Capital) is asking for a POC. Requirements: strict EU-only processing + BYOK, but they want an escape path to us-west for DR. Need: sub-processor list, IP ranges for tenant pinning, delta on egress/network costs, and how routing policy would be configured. Who can own the answers?
elaine_se: I can take presales on this. Quick Q: is the customer insisting on absolute no-cross-border at rest/processing except during DR failover?
sam_sales: Yes, regs allow emergency failover to us-west with signed policy and audit trail. They also want cost split for any cross-region tokens.
pete_infra: Short answers first: we support tenant pin + geofence routing. For POC we can set route_preference to "EU_PREFERRED" with failover to allowed regions. Example config we usually give:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "cypress-001",
  "route_preference": "EU_ONLY", // options: EU_ONLY, EU_PREFERRED, ANY
  "failover_regions": ["us-west-2"],
  "byok": true
}
```
Note: EU_ONLY prevents cross-region compute unless operator override (requires documented approval).
maria_legal: Need exact sub-processor list and certs before we present. I can sign off if subproc list includes EU datacenter providers + our legal attestation.
pete_infra: Subproc list link: https://internal.redwood.com/subprocessors (will attach POC subset). IP ranges: we can provide tenant pinning CIDR blocks per-region. For POC I suggest scoped pin: EU control plane + EU compute nodes.
sam_sales: Pricing ask: they want incremental cost if failover used. How do we surface that?
pete_infra: Hosted billing is per-token processed regionally. If failover triggers processing in us-west, tokens billed at us-west unit rate + network egress charges. We normally estimate ~+12-18% on unit token cost for cross-region due to egress and different infra pricing. We can provide a contract addendum to cap cross-region egress for POC.
elaine_se: I'll prepare a short presales doc: (1) technical routing options, (2) subproc list & certs, (3) sample contract language for capped egress, (4) BYOK flow.
elaine_se: BYOK note - for Private/Dedicated we can bring your key (KMS/HSM) and ensure keys never leave target VPC. For Hosted BYOK we use envelope encryption with customer KMS and audit logs. See https://docs.redwood.com/security/byok
ops_oncall: SLO/ops note: if failover occurs automated rollback to EU is manual by default for DR acceptance; we can enable automated revert but need runbook and runbook test during POC.
maria_legal: Also add a required question into their security questionnaire: "Under what conditions will Redwood initiate cross-border processing for this tenant?" We need explicit thresholds.
sam_sales: Cool — Elaine please bundle and I'll send to procurement team. Pete, can you drop the POC subnet/cidr + estimated egress example by EOD?
pete_infra: Yep, will post attachment with CIDRs and a sample cost calc.
deploy-bot: Demo slot reserved: POC kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-05-02 16:00 UTC — invite sent. :calendar: 
elaine_se: Thanks — I'll draft the doc and cc legal. Quick follow-up: do we want to propose a canary for routing (10% traffic to failover region) during POC or fully manual?
pete_infra: Recommend manual failover for first run, then canary at 1% if procurement wants to validate automatic behavior.
sam_sales: Perfect. I'll update the customer. :thumbsup:
